notes.title: (Promo) OKJOY's "Cavalry Girls" shooter game is now live!
notes.notes:
Published by OKJOY, the light Rogue mech-girl top-down shooter "Cavalry Girls" is set to officially launch on the Steam platform at 01:00 Pacific Time today (October 20th)! The game has a total playtime of over 20 hours!

Store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055050/_/?utm_source=tonggao&utm_campaign=shoufa

[h3]Game Introduction:[/h3]
Cavalry Girls is a light roguelike top-down shooter indie game. In this game, players will lead Cavalry Girls into battles against enemy forces. Modify various mecha models, strategically deploy mechas with different skills, repel the overwhelming enemies, and defend your empire amid the raging fires. With limited supplies, players will have to make wise resource allocations, manage soldiers and survive on an increasingly intense battlefield.

[h3]Game Featured[/h3]
[b]
Top-Down Shooting[/b]

- Experience the authentic shooting feel and enjoy the thrilling battlefield.
- A plethora of equipment modules to choose from, with each weapon offering distinct effects.
- Engage in rogue-like combat against dozens of enemy types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/da19247ff2bf6466bd226ca5d72d91175477b64a.gif[/img]
[b]
Strategic Deployment[/b]

- Choose your favorite equipment and teammates and pick modules to build the most powerful mecha.
- Gather intelligence for strategic deployment and strike enemies based on their unique characteristics.
- Make decisions using limited resources - take risks or play it safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/82762e0d6f028ec0da94c5d734abab766a52bebb.gif[/img]

[b]Casual Gameplay[/b]

- Five recruitable characters with distinct personalities. Choose your favorite Cavalry Girls to accompany you in battle.
- Arrange cozy dorms for Cavalry Girls and give them gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/a8e869f4ba3bf18ca467dff232593b444f7f7bc5.gif[/img]

notes.title: OKJOY brings diverse gaming to the Chinajoy x Game Connection event!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! OKJOY will participate in the Chinajoy x Game Connection event on July 26th, bringing along our games "HAAK", "Moolii's Dreamland", "The Heroes Around Me", "Taoism", "The Road of Gaokao", and "Avici".

We offer a diverse range of games to meet the needs of all gaming enthusiasts. Whether you're a fan of adventure games, puzzle games, or strategy games, you can find your niche in the games listed below. Now, start with the game descriptions and links below, choose the game you're interested in, and dive into an exciting demo play experience right away!

HAAK：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1352930/HAAK/
Intro：HAAK is a Metroidvania-Platformer. As the mysterious wanderer Haak, you embarked on an epic expedition across the vast cyber-wasteland to find your lost brother. Explore deserted cities and metro, refine your weapons and hack skills, and uncover the secrets behind metal and dust.

Moolii's Dreamland：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280380/Mooliis_Dreamland/
Intro：Help Moolii on her nightmare of the forest! Use claws and bullets and dodge in the roguelite bullet-hell where all Moolii's cuttie friends become Mobs and Bosses! Collect and upgrade bullets to help Moolii!

The Heroes Around Me：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1768470/The_Heroes_Around_Me/
Intro：The Heroes Around Me tells a story of a family of 3: the hard-working and quiet father – Nan, his daughter Lili, and their pet dog Sesame. Players will experience the harshness and warmth in the simpler time of the 1990s, where lots of stories are untold.

Taoism：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331080/Taoism/
Intro：Taoism is a rougelike card game inspired by Chinese mythical tales. When evil spirits are all over the space, you’ll explore the mysterious country Luo Nan, use different cards to defeat Taoist priests as well as evil spirits and find the truth of the decline of Luo Nan.

The Road of Gaokao：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1705420/_/
Intro："The Road of Gaokao" is a unique Roguelike card game where you will face a Gaokao countdown of just 100 days. A hundred days of sprinting, a hundred days of change. From study to routine, from diet to exercise, from emotion control to test-taking strategy, meticulously plan and fortify step by step, give it your all, and optimize your preparation plan.

Avici：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2050520/Avici/
Intro：Use the daytime to search for treasures, trade with hermits, and investigate the strange experiences of former expedition members; Or with limited oxygen and lighting equipment, dive deep into the endless darkness of the seabed, escape the threat of unknown creatures, and seek powerful technology.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest draws to a close, thanks to the support of players!
notes.notes:
Dear fellow players,

The Steam Next Fest has come to a successful end! We would like to thank you all for your participation and support over the past few days. It is your enthusiasm and vitality that have made this event so vibrant and dynamic.

Throughout the event, we received a wealth of valuable feedback and suggestions, which are an important part of our continuous improvement process.

Although the Steam Next Fest has come to an end, you can still enjoy our Demo on Steam and provide us with more feedback and suggestions!

Once again, we would like to thank each and every one of you for your participation and support.

notes.title: The Road of Gaokao Demo Update Announcement - 25 June 2023
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The demo of "The Road of Gaokao" will be updated on June 25, 2023. This update includes multiple game optimizations and bug fixes to provide you with a smoother gaming experience. Here are the detailed contents of this update:

Fixed the bug of still being charged without dining in the cafeteria
Fixed the bug of consecutive dish ordering in the cafeteria overwriting the previous dish
Fixed the bug of repeatedly entering the mini-map
Fixed the bug of tutoring class guidance not being triggered properly
Fixed the bug of certain events not being triggered properly
Optimized the generation level of prompt UI
Optimized the card hierarchy
Optimized the interaction of lens animation
Optimized the wording of spoils of war
Thank you for your continuous support. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: "The Road of Gaokao" Now Debuts at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Everything is ready, a tense yet expectant 100-day Gaokao sprint is waiting for you. "The Road of Gaokao" officially debuts at Steam Next Fest! We wish every candidate a successful completion and arrival at their dream school!

The New Game Festival started at 10:00 a.m. on June 19 Pacific Time and will continue until 10:00 a.m. on June 26. During this period, we cordially invite you to try "The Road of Gaokao" for free.

[b]Steam store page: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1705420/_/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42435600/c49a115fd137f11979fe7242712a66eae444fb7b.jpg[/img]

"The Road of Gaokao" is a unique Roguelike card game where you will face a Gaokao countdown of just 100 days. A hundred days of sprinting, a hundred days of change. From study to routine, from diet to exercise, from emotion control to test-taking strategy, meticulously plan and fortify step by step, give it your all, and optimize your preparation plan.

During the demo period, we welcome and look forward to every piece of feedback and suggestion from you. We will listen wholeheartedly to the voices of players, in order to bring you a better gaming experience. Let's challenge the 100-day sprint of "The Road of Gaokao" in the Steam Next Fest together!

notes.title: "The Road of Gaokao" Joins Steam Next Fest event!
notes.notes:
Embrace the challenge and experience the tense yet passionate hundred-day sprint to the college entrance examination, "The Road of Gaokao" is about to meet you at the Steam Next Fest event! May every examinee get into the university of their dreams! ~

Steam Next Fest event will unveil at 10 a.m. on June 19 and will continue until 10 a.m. on June 26 Pacific time. During this period, we sincerely invite you to try "The Road of Gaokao" for free.

In this Roguelike card game "The Road of Gaokao", you will take over a simulator facing the countdown of only a hundred days before the college entrance examination. A hundred days of sprinting, a hundred days of change, from study to rest, from diet to exercise, from emotional control to examination strategy, meticulous planning and step-by-step arrangements to polish and optimize your preparation plan.

During the trial, we look forward to and welcome your feedback and suggestions. We will wholeheartedly listen to the voice of the players and strive to bring you a better gaming experience. Let's challenge the hundred-day sprint of "The Road of Gaokao" at the Steam Next Fest event together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42435600/42eb4625e94bdb46e570e01f388f1a307a1f59e6.jpg[/img]
